brand.name: Airbnb
brand.elevatorPitch: Airbnb has welcomed 1.5 billion arrivals, all thanks to our 5 million Hosts. We’re creating connection and belonging in the world, with a global creative community where people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can thrive.
brand.boilerplate: About Airbnb: Airbnb welcomed its first three guests in 2007 and has since welcomed 1.5 billion arrivals through 5 million Hosts. Its careers pages emphasize connection, belonging, creativity, and collaboration. Airbnb offers employees flexibility to live and work anywhere in the world where regulations allow, alongside opportunities to connect in person.
brand.description: Get an Airbnb for every kind of trip → 8 million vacation rentals → 2 million Guest Favorites → 220+ countries and regions worldwide

voice.summary: The supplied copy is primarily careers-led: welcoming, creatively ambitious, and direct about flexibility and belonging. It pairs human invitations with concrete scale and practical qualifications.

traits.name: Belonging expressed personally
traits.description: Addresses readers directly and frames inclusion as being welcomed, empowered, and able to contribute.
traits.do: Use you and your to connect belonging with a concrete experience or opportunity.
traits.dont: Describe people as interchangeable resources or make belonging sound like an exclusive privilege.

evidence.quote: We’re committed to ensuring Airbnb is a place where people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can thrive.

traits.name: Creatively ambitious
traits.description: Uses expansive language about creative work and impact, supported by invitations to participate.
traits.do: Pair an ambitious headline with a specific action, role, or collaborative opportunity.
traits.dont: Rely on abstract innovation jargon without explaining what people can do.

evidence.quote: Work at one of the most creative places on Earth
Join our global creative community, where passion and collaboration drive innovation to make products that impact the world.

traits.name: Human flexibility with practical boundaries
traits.description: Acknowledges individual needs while clearly qualifying what the company offers.
traits.do: State the human benefit first, then include relevant limitations in plain language.
traits.dont: Promise unrestricted freedom or hide qualifications behind legalistic phrasing.

evidence.quote: We know there is no one-size-fits-all approach to work.

styleRules: Use short, invitation-led headings; sentence case predominates, with title case retained for named phrases such as Live and Work Anywhere.
Keep body sentences near the measured average of 19 words, using plain high-school-level language.
Use we and our for the company, and you and your when addressing readers directly.
Use contractions naturally but sparingly; avoid exclamation marks and rhetorical questions.
Present scale with numerals, as in 2007, 1.5 billion, and 5 million; capitalize Hosts when referring to Airbnb Hosts.
State practical qualifications explicitly rather than presenting benefits as unconditional.

pillars.message: Airbnb presents a welcoming workplace as the starting point for creating connection and belonging in the world.

proof.quote: Creating connection and belonging in the world begins with a workplace where you're both welcomed and empowered to be your authentic self, so you can deliver your best work.

pillars.headline: Flexibility recognizes individual needs
pillars.message: Employees can live and work across the world where regulations allow, while retaining opportunities for in-person connection.

proof.quote: We know there is no one-size-fits-all approach to work.

pillars.headline: Creative collaboration drives impact
pillars.message: Airbnb invites people to join a global creative community and collaborate on products that impact the world.

proof.quote: Join our global creative community, where passion and collaboration drive innovation to make products that impact the world.
Work alongside industry-leading talent and be part of our vibrant network, encompassing people from all walks of life.
